## Summary

The IEEE registry lists 34 MA-L blocks to Shenzhen SuperElectron
Technology Co.,Ltd., all at the Haosheng Business Center on Dongbin
Road, Nanshan, Shenzhen, China [1]. One of them, E8:26:8D, was
registered on 8 September 2022 [2]. Nothing else is documented here:
the company's website did not answer, the FCC ID databases refused the
session that wrote this entry, web search was unavailable, and no
product, module, chipset or brand could be tied to the blocks from a
fetched source, so every other field is unknown rather than guessed
[1][2].
